race.comment: CHARLECOTE MILL (7) finished second at Hamilton two runs back but didn't measure up last time over 1600m at Warracknabeal, finishing 4 lengths back in eighth. She looked a horse of some talent earlier in the year and while she is struggling to rediscover that form, this looks well within her grasp. THOUGHTFUL (2) finished third two runs back at Hamilton then improved last time out to score by a neck over 1600m at Warracknabeal. Tom Madden scored on him last time and retains the mount, which looks a plus. TUDAYA (6) has been up for a while but is generally around the mark in this company. WHISTLER GIRL (10) has run improved races at her past two and is worthy of consideration again.
